# Guardian V4

A hybrid autonomous engineering protocol for active architectural governance.

## Core Concepts
- **Guardian Sentry**: Real-time violation detection and system locking.
- **Guru Architect**: Autonomous RAG-driven remediation.
- **STALL/LOCK**: Physical developmental lockdown on critical violations.

## File Structure
- `src-tauri`: Rust backend for monitoring logic.
- `src/components`: React/Tailwind frontend for Control Hub.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: Version history.
- `README.md`: Setup and protocol overview.

## Guidelines
Follow SPAP v2.2 for all modifications. No violet/purple hex codes. Ensure 110% global scaling.
